ex.s: Here was this challenging student who had a reputation for single-mindedness and good grades—the exact opposite of me.

ex.s: Recently，I took a trip home by train．I got a seat opposite a middle-aged man with sharp eyes，who kept____1____a young woman in a window seat with a little boy on her lap．The woman's eye fell on the man's face，and she immediately looked down and____2____her scarf．
ex.t: 最近我坐火车回老家．我对面坐着一位目光锐利的中年男子他一直在____1____盯着窗边座位上一个抱着小孩的年轻女士看．那位女士的目光落在男士脸上她立刻低下头并____2____围紧了围巾．

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关联的新型计时方式这些状况可能因全球变暖而发生变化．我们正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座钟它反映了几条主要阿拉斯加河流的总流量这些河流对当地和全球的环境变化都很敏感．我们已经编程让它在水流保持当前速率时与原子钟同步．如果将来河流平均流速加快钟会比标准时间走得快．如果河流变慢你会看到相反的效果．
你想成为一名高效的演讲者。

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 世界各地的父母都在夸奖他们的孩子。

defs.def: facing the speaker or sb/sth that has been mentioned 用于名词后

ex.s: If “hard” is the opposite of “soft”, why are “hardly” and “softly” not an opposing pair?
ex.t: 如果＂hard＂是＂soft＂的反义词，那为什么＂hardly＂和＂softly＂不是一对反义词？

ex.s: If harmless actions are the opposite of harmful actions, why are shameless and shameful behaviors the same?
ex.t: 如果无害的行为是有害行为的反义词，那为什么无耻和可耻的行为意思相同？

ex.s: As they gathered in the public square, one of them, the chicken, was seen by her neighbours going in the opposite direction.
ex.t: 当它们聚集在公共广场上时，其中一个——小鸡——被她的邻居看到朝相反的方向走去。

defs.def: as different as possible from sth 相反的；迥然不同的

ex.s: If you add un- or in- to a word, the new word usually means the opposite.
ex.t: 如果你在一个词前面加上un-或in-，新词通常表示相反的意思。
